SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Compare the fishing boat, daily route and transfer to the lodge separately from a sightseeing cruise. Ask whether tackle and landing equipment are included. A dedicated pike plan should not inherit every species and technique listed for the entire delta.

Choose the access before the outfit

Lake fishing can mean a bank session, trolling, jigging or a guided casting day. Confirm which of those is actually offered. Check boat and equipment provision before buying a second setup, and keep the personal day bag distinct from shared tackle.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Romania

Recreational fishing in natural waters requires a named permit from the authority or the relevant fishing association. Check the water's manager; the Danube Delta has a separate fishing permit and visitor access permit.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Holbina private-fishery voucher ↗
    Guests fishing the resort’s private ponds Book a fishing package or day with the resort.

Rules for this water

  • The resort’s private ponds use its access voucher; the manager states that ARBDD fishing permits do not apply there.
  • Public Delta waters outside the private ponds require separate ARBDD fishing and visitor permissions.
